A small beauty mark on the neck, above the lip or on the cheek highlights and accentuates their shape and contour. You'll feel much more confident! A semi-permanent beauty mark takes just a few minutes, is a completely painless procedure and delivers stunning results: a detail that draws attention to your look. The effect lasts for 3 years. So for all that time you'll feel attractive and charming, and you'll fall in love with yourself.

tvs.title-bl-seo: Get a beauty mark tattoo and become even more charming and alluring
tvs.text-bl-seo: In the past, anything acquired or inherited made a person feel special. Some birthmarks, such as moles, were even used to read a person's future or fate. In the 17th–18th centuries, a beauty mark was considered a symbol of seduction, wealth and prosperity. Women back then wanted a beauty mark on their face so much that they wore special little patches. Today, a beauty mark on the face or body no longer carries any secret meaning. Yet it still sends the same message it did centuries ago.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
Ah, that beauty mark...

You're mistaken if you think a beauty mark is just a minor detail. In fact, a beauty mark tattooed in the right spot and in the right shade can have a remarkable effect. See for yourself:

  • A beauty mark tattoo helps restore facial symmetry. It makes the face look visually balanced.
  • A beauty mark accentuates your look. And it doesn't matter where it's placed: cheek, face, shoulder, neck, décolleté, abdomen. A cute beauty mark is sure to catch the eye.
  • A beauty mark draws attention away from any imperfection. In fact, it can become an attractive feature of your look.

You've probably noticed that most celebrities have a beauty mark on their face. Just as in the past, it captivates the eye. Many stars have had a beauty mark tattooed. So don't hesitate – if you'd like a neat beauty mark of your own, book an affordable permanent makeup appointment.

Steps of the semi-permanent beauty mark procedure

The procedure takes no more than 10–15 minutes. This includes drawing the sketch and choosing the shade that best matches your skin tone. The sketch is very important in this technique: you need to see what the beauty mark will look like and whether it suits the chosen spot. You can change the shade and size. Once the sketch is approved, the artist performs the tattoo. No anesthetic is used during the procedure. For this reason, a beauty mark tattoo can be done for pregnant women and breastfeeding new mothers.

Contraindications

Please note that a permanent makeup beauty mark has contraindications. The procedure must not be performed in the following cases:

  • malignant skin tumors;
  • covering a natural mole;
  • insulin-dependent diabetes;
  • human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), AIDS;
  • epilepsy;
  • nervous disorders;
  • viral illnesses.

We recommend rescheduling the procedure if you feel unwell or have a fever or high blood pressure.

Beauty mark micropigmentation, part of your playful look

It doesn't matter how old you are. A tattooed beauty mark looks beautiful and charming at any age. It suits absolutely every woman, whatever her skin type. So take a step toward femininity, self-assertion and self-confidence. Get an affordable semi-permanent beauty mark and enjoy all the benefits of this amazing offer.

migx_questions.questions-title: How long does a beauty mark tattoo last?
migx_questions.questions-text: On average, up to 2.5–3 years. It depends on where the beauty mark is placed. If clothing often rubs against it (for example, if the tattoo is on the shoulder), the result will stay visible for a shorter time.

migx_questions.questions-title: Where is the best place for a semi-permanent beauty mark?
migx_questions.questions-text: The most popular placement is above or below the lip. However, you can have one absolutely anywhere you like. The studio's artist will choose the most suitable size based on the shape of your face or body.

migx_questions.questions-title: How is the beauty mark shade chosen?
migx_questions.questions-text: The shade is selected individually based on your skin tone. The standard color is brown, in various shades. However, if you have dark skin, you can even go for black. It all depends on your preferences. The lighter your skin and hair, the lighter the pigment shade, so that the beauty mark looks as natural as possible.

migx_questions.questions-title: Can a tattoo be applied over a natural mole?
migx_questions.questions-text: It's not recommended to touch or traumatize moles you've had since birth, so as not to cause injury.
